rca of the issue: Prior double-slash bug root cause: VITE_API_URL on Vercel was set with a trailing '/' → axios constructed 'https://bajiman-server.vercel.app//api/...' → double-slash path caused CORS preflight to fail for catalog + 9Wicket launch from live client. Mitigation deployed: strip trailing slashes with .replace(/\/+$/,'') in client/src/api/axios.js and PlayGame.jsx. Verified in live bundle and via live E2E — 0 double-slash requests, 0 CORS errors.
